mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) creates stagflation risk that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Early-phase monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) suppresses corporate investment and consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days during the first 6 months of rate hikes.
regime_hint: early phase of monetary tightening cycle
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during the first 6 months of FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing output that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls by >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000.0 units indicate strong residential construction demand that drives consumer spending growth and corporate revenue expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales increase exceeding 1.0% signals robust consumer spending that accelerates corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS rises by >1.0% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth exceeding 0.5% and unemployment decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points indicate labor market strength that boosts consumer income and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 1 month and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS rises by >0.5% and UNRATE falls by >0.2pp.
